headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Fell In October, Where Does Fair Value Sit Now?
headlines.summary: Datadog (DDOG) is back in focus after its share price fell nearly 12% in October as investors reassessed AI related spending across cloud software stocks. That October slide sits on top of a much stronger run for Datadog, with the share price still up 75.88% on a year to date basis and total shareholder return of 45.16% over one year. As a result, the recent pullback looks more like a reset in risk appetite than a shift in the underlying story.

headlines.title: Datadog Sinks 12%, CrowdStrike Falls 4% Despite $6.3 Billion Binance Hack Spotlighting Cyber Defense; Palo Alto and Fortinet Slide 3%
headlines.summary: A $6.3 billion crypto heist put cybersecurity in the headlines, yet the stocks that should benefit are tumbling alongside the rest of tech. The reason traces back to something far bigger than one hack.

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
